READ | The Philippine Consulate General in Hong Kong reported that, as of 8 p.m. today, a total of 63 Filipinos affected by the Tai Po fire incident have been confirmed safe. 

One Filipino sustained injuries and is currently receiving medical assistance, while another individual remains missing and cannot be contacted.

The consulate also noted that 28 more individuals are still undergoing verification. These individuals are believed to be residents of the affected area, but their whereabouts have not yet been confirmed. | via Katrina Manubay

📷: Philippine Consulate in Hong Kong

For more info, visit https://t.co/rmQCnNSOvI.

MAHALAGANG ABISO SA MGA MOTORISTA🚦

Bunsod ng isasagawang 'Trillion Peso March' ng Church Leaders Council for National Transformation (CLCNT), asahan ang pagbagal ng daloy ng trapiko sa paligid ng EDSA People Power Monument sa Linggo, November 30, 2025, mula 8:00 AM kabilang ang mga sumusunod na kalsada:

• Epifanio Delos Santos Avenue (EDSA)
• Katipunan Avenue
• Ortigas Avenue
• White Plains Avenue
• Temple Drive

Bilang paghahanda sa nasabing aktibidad, magpapatupad din ng zipper lane sa kahabaan ng White Plains Avenue sa pagitan ng EDSA at Katipunan Avenue simula 9:00 PM ng November 29, hanggang 6:00 AM ng November 30, 2025.

Pansamantala namang isasara ang White Plains Avenue sa mismong araw ng rally, November 30, 2025, mula 6:00 ng umaga.
